name: preview-card-2g
title: Preview Card 2g: Tinted folder tab
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. 1g with a blue tab for Themes. The tab tucks behind the card, and the card has all four corners rounded.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
